<th class="th" colspan="1">6 Months Ended</th>

<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_DisclosureTextBlockAbstract', window );"><strong>Notes to Financial Statements</strong></a></td>

<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_DerivativesAndFairValueTextBlock', window );">Derivatives and Fair Value [Text Block]</a></td>
<td class="text">
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note <em style="font: inherit;">8</em> </b>&#8211;<b> Capital Commitments</b> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> July 6, 2023, </em>the Company entered into a Capital Commitment Agreement (&#8220;Agreement&#8221;) with GEM Global Yield LLC SCS (&#8220;GGY&#8221;), under the terms of which GGY has agreed to provide the Company with up to <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c149067968">$30</span> million Australian dollars through a Security Subscription Facility (the &#8220;Facility&#8221;) over a 3-year term. The Agreement allows the Company to draw down funds during the 3-year term by giving GGY <em style="font: inherit;">15</em> Australian Securities Exchange (&#8220;ASX&#8221;) trading days&#8217; notice to subscribe for CDIs, subject to share lending arrangement(s) being in place. The number of CDIs which GGY <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>subscribe for is capped at 700% of the average daily number of CDIs traded on the ASX during the <em style="font: inherit;">15</em> trading days prior to the relevant drawdown notice, subject to certain adjustments. The subscription price of the CDIs to be issued to GGY is the higher of (i) 90% of the average closing bid price of the Company&#8217;s CDIs over the <em style="font: inherit;">15</em> consecutive trading days after the Company gives the drawdown notice, subject to certain adjustments; or (ii) a fixed floor price nominated by the Company in the drawdown notice. The Company controls the timing of drawdowns under the Facility and has <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> minimum drawdown obligation. The issue of CDIs to GGY pursuant to any drawdown notice will also be conditional on the Company having sufficient placement capacity under ASX Listing Rules <em style="font: inherit;">7.1</em> or <em style="font: inherit;">7.1A</em> (as applicable) or obtaining any requisite securityholder approval for the issue.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>


   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The Agreement meets the definition of a derivative in accordance with ASC <em style="font: inherit;">815</em> and is measured at fair value. Any changes in fair value of such instruments are recorded in other income (expense) on the unaudited condensed consolidated statements of operations.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">The following table provides a summary of the change in fair value of the derivate asset for the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">six</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> June 30</em>:</p>
   <p style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">As the Agreement approached its contractual expiration on <em style="font: inherit;"> July 6, 2026, </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> further drawdowns were expected prior expiry, our fair&#8209;value assessment as of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>, resulted in the derivative asset being reduced to zero. The derivative asset&#8217;s fair value as of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, was calculated using the Monte Carlo Simulation model utilizing the following assumptions:</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>&#160;and&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the fair values of the CDI options of&#160;$4,286,736&#160;and&#160;$3,157,717, respectively, are classified as current liabilities on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The fair value of CDI options was determined using the Black-Scholes option pricing model with assumptions consistent in methodology to those used for stock options, except that the contractual life of the options is used as the expected term and volatility of the stock price is estimated based on the Company's own historical volatility.<br/>&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">Since issuance, the Company has drawn $444,922 Australian dollars on the Facility, and $29,555,078 Australian dollars is available as of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>. Converted to U.S. dollars using the exchange rate of <em style="font: inherit;">$1</em> Australian dollar to $0.69 U.S. dollar as of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>, these amounts are $305,617 and $20,301,383, respectively.</p>
